name: KANA Y.
about_me: I live in Koenji, Tokyo. Koenji is just a 6minutes train ride from Shinjuku. Despite being close to the city center, you can experience the good old days of Japanese life and get a real local experience. There are many izakayas that are not chain restaurants, making it a great place for weekend nightlife. I was born in Hokkaido, Japan. Hokkaido is the northernmost large island of Japan and it gets cold and snowy in the winter. Hokkaido is famous for the ski resort of Niseko. I grew up in a snowy country, so I love winter. I can concentrate on working indoors with a hot coffee on a dark, cold, quiet morning.
